notes.title: Version 1.024 update description
notes.notes: Dear all! Update to version 1.024 adds ladders to this game and fixes some minor bugs. In order to let hero climb onto these ladders new button was added to the control set. It is “UP” by default, however, could be changed in the “Settings” menu.

notes.title: Update v. 1.023
notes.notes:
Dear friends, Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
The Update 1.023 is coming.
It fixes issues in game performance and rendering.
Please, update your distributions.
